#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

class IntStack {
public:
    vector<int> array;
    int size = 0;

    IntStack() {
        array.reserve(8);
    }

    void push(int item) {
        if (size >= (int)array.size()) {
            resize();
        }
        if (size < (int)array.size()) {
            array[size] = item;
        } else {
            array.push_back(item);
        }
        size++;
    }

    int get(int i) const {
        assert(i < size);
        return array[i];
    }

    int getSize() const {
        return size;
    }

private:
    void resize() {
        array.resize(array.size() * 2 + 1);
    }
};

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
    public:
        IntStack factorial;
        IntStack invFactorial;

        Modulus() {
            factorial.push(1);
            invFactorial.push(1);
        }

        virtual long long modulus() const = 0;

        long long fact(int n) {
            while (factorial.getSize() <= n) {
                long long val = mult(factorial.get(factorial.getSize() - 1), factorial.getSize());
                factorial.push((int)val);
            }
            return factorial.get(n);
        }

        long long fInv(int n) {
            int lastKnown = invFactorial.getSize() - 1;
            if (lastKnown < n) {
                vector<long long> fInv(n - lastKnown);
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < (int)fInv.size(); i++) {
                    fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i - 1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = (int)fInv.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    invFactorial.push((int)fInv[i]);
                }
            }
            return invFactorial.get(n);
        }

        long long ncr(int n, int r) {
            if (n < 0 || r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }

        long long smallInv(int n) {
            return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
        }

        long long normalize(long long x) const {
            long long m = modulus();
            x %= m;
            if (x < 0) x += m;
            return x;
        }

        long long add(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v = a + b;
            long long m = modulus();
            return v < m ? v : v - m;
        }

        long long subtract(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v = a - b;
            long long m = modulus();
            return v < 0 ? v + m : v;
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long m = modulus();
            return (a * b) % m;
        }

        long long mult(const vector<long long>& x) const {
            long long r = 1;
            for (auto i : x) {
                r = mult(r, i);
            }
            return r;
        }

        long long inv(long long value) const {
            long long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            long long r = value;
            while (r != 0) {
                long long q = g / r;
                long long temp = g % r;
                g = r;
                r = temp;

                temp = x - q * y;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }
            assert(g == 1);
            assert(y == modulus() || y == -modulus());
            return normalize(x);
        }
    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    public:
        long long modulus() const override {
            return 998244353LL;
        }
    };
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;

    // Precompute inverse of (n + m)
    mod.fInv(n + m);

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = mod.mult(p, n - i, mod.inv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long term = mod.mult(mod.ncr(n, k), m + k, mod.inv(k), phaseSize);
        if (k % 2 == 1) {
            answer = mod.add(answer, term);
        } else {
            answer = mod.subtract(answer, term);
        }
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
